fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (NASDAQ: SNDK) fell 8% on TrendForce's forecast of NAND price declines in Q1 2027, experiencing greater impact than Micron (5% decline) and SK Hynix (4% decline) due to pure NAND exposure.
fields.summary_ko.1: Spot prices have already fallen 20%+ due to industry capex increase of 25–30% and reduced Chinese cloud orders, with Q1 2027 NAND contract prices expected to decline 0–5%.
fields.summary_ko.2: SanDisk holds half its 2027 fiscal year bits under data center contracts; however, margin pressure is possible from new contract repricing.
